query: Which projects have the highest number of listed assets for lease vs sale?
What is the distribution of assets per project and asset type?
sql: SELECT "t0"."project_name", "t3"."name" AS "asset_type", COUNT("t2"."id") AS "document_count" FROM "assets_asset" AS "t0" JOIN "assets_project" AS "t1" ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."project_id" JOIN "assets_assetverificationdocument" AS "t2" ON "t2"."asset_id" = "t0"."id" JOIN "assets_assetverificationdocumenttype" AS "t3" ON "t3"."id" = "t2"."verification_document_type_id" GROUP BY "t0"."project_name", "t3"."name" LIMIT 100
